component.name: GJSGebra
component.summary: Dynamic mathematics: graphing, geometry and algebra

description.p: GJSGebra runs the GeoGebra kernel natively on Linux. The Java kernel is compiled to JavaScript and executed in GJS, drawn with Cairo and Pango, inside a GTK4 / libadwaita shell.

ul.li: Graphing perspective with algebra view, function plotting and the tool palette
Scientific calculator with a typeset history and persistent variables
Computer algebra through Giac compiled to WebAssembly: limits, derivatives, integrals, factoring and solving
Native GTK input: two-finger pan, pinch to zoom, mouse wheel zoom

screenshot.caption: Graphing perspective with the algebra view
Scientific calculator, with the computer algebra system

description.p: First release: graphing and scientific calculator perspectives, Giac computer algebra, native GTK gestures, Flatpak packaging.
